primary_x: untransformed shortest coast distance in km
site_regression: OLS of equal-weight station MAE; each site own available dates, descriptive
date_regression: Within-date centering; equal date weight and equal available station weight within date; no station FE
bootstrap: 2000 circular 14-day calendar blocks, seed 3536; fixed sites and frozen offset fits
limitations: Sparse inland sites; spatial station dependence and training-fit uncertainty not captured; exploratory, no causal interpretation or linear extrapolation
